knownIssues.title: Timing chain tensioner wear (EA211 1.2 TSI)
knownIssues.description: Early EA211 1.2 TSI engines can suffer premature timing chain tensioner wear, leading to chain rattle on cold start and, in severe cases, chain skip.

fixes.summary: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
fixes.steps: Remove the timing cover, replace the chain, tensioner and guide rails as a set, then reset timing to factory marks.

knownIssues.title: Coil pack / ignition coil failure
knownIssues.description: Ignition coils on this engine family can fail intermittently, causing misfires and a rough idle, especially in damp weather.

fixes.steps: Identify the misfiring cylinder via OBD-II fault codes, then replace the affected coil pack(s).
